
All functions download from official sources and cache the result locally,
so the chunks below are not evaluated when the vignette is built.

```{r}
library(helvetia)

gem  <- gemeinde(date = as.Date("2021-01-01"))
pop  <- popGemeinde(year = 2021)
geo  <- geoGemeinde(date = as.Date("2021-01-01"))
area <- arealGemeinde(period = "2013/18", nClasses = 17)

# aggregate the statistics before joining them to the map
popTotal <- aggregate(ch_n ~ gem_id, data = pop, FUN = sum)
br <- cut(log10(popTotal$ch_n), 6)
plotMap(geo, id = popTotal$gem_id,
        col = hcl.colors(6, "Blues 3", rev = TRUE)[br], border = NA)
```

## Thematic maps

The generalised ThemaKart geometries of the BFS (formerly used through
bfsMaps) are downloaded automatically:

```{r}
plotMap("kanton", id = c("ZH", "BE", "TI"),
        col = c("steelblue", "orange", "darkseagreen"), labels = TRUE)
addGewaesser()

# premium regions of the mandatory health insurance
preg <- praemienregion(2026)
reg  <- combineRegions(geoGemeinde("2026-01-01"), preg$preg_x, preg$gem_id)
plotMap(reg, col = hcl.colors(nrow(reg), "Set 3"), labels = TRUE)
```

## Time concepts

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `stand_d` | exact date of a register or geometry stand |
| `jahr_n` | statistical year |
| `period_x` | multi-year survey period, e.g. `"2013/18"` |
| `gem_stand_d` | municipality boundaries a result is reported on |

A population figure for 2021 refers to the municipalities of 31.12.2021,
the Arealstatistik 2013/18 to the boundary stand in `gem_stand_d`. Check
which municipalities match before joining:

```{r}
setdiff(unique(pop$gem_id), gem$gem_id)
```

## Sources and cache

```{r}
sourceInfo(area)
cacheList()
```
